page.overview:
Who is Shell Blowers?

The Shell Blowers are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"Alert! From their posts high above the colony, watch ants sound the alarm. The grasshoppers are coming! Blasts from their empty snail shells echo across ant island, striking terror into the ants' hearts―but giving them time to run for cover."
